digest.component_or_area: test design standards and convergence test oracles
propositions: Convergence tests that re-derive the external-effect side instead of capturing it from the real call site stay green when the production code drifts, failing to catch the regressions they exist to detect

The concrete defect (stale truncate_comment_body model and re-derived fit_preserving_marker composition) was fixed by commit 103729e90c, which now captures the --body argument from acli_cli_ops.add_comment with only acli_subprocess._run_acli stubbed

The rule must be documented in shared test-design.md §4 with both instances as worked examples, then synced byte-identically to per-skill copies (rebar-debug, rebar-implement, rebar-brainstorm) and gated by test_skill_shared_sync.py

A mechanical lint check flagging tests importing the same fit helper on both sides of an equality cannot distinguish sanctioned characterization tests (e.g. test_dc_fit_comment_is_the_send_path_fit) from defective re-derived oracles without unacceptable false positives across 17 test files
